d: ControlSpace ESP-880A engineered sound processor High-quality analog circuitry offers both mic and line-level I/O, operates with ultra-low noise and 115 dB dynamic range.

specs.label: Channel Separation (Crosstalk)
specs.value: < -105 dB at +4 dBu, 1 kHz input signal

specs.label: Dynamic Range
specs.value: > 115 dB, A-weighted, 20 Hz – 20 kHz, analog through

specs.label: Equivalent Input Noise
specs.value: < -119 dBu at 64 dB gain (150 Ω input, 22 Hz – 20 kHz)

specs.label: Sensitivity Options
specs.value: 0 dB, +14 dB, +24 dB, +32 dB, +44 dB, +54 dB, +64 dB, pre-gain

specs.label: Input Impedance
specs.value: 12 kΩ at 1 kHz, with or without phantom power
